claims.text: A ring operating from April to August 2026 targeted job seekers across at least six Nepali districts with fake factory-worker offers in Malaysia promising NPR 200,000 monthly salary. Victims were recruited via Viber groups and a Facebook page, then induced to pay stepwise fees (registration, insurance deposit, visa processing) to an IME Pay wallet and a Zentaro Bank account, after which the recruiters cited visa delays and cut contact. Forty-seven victims reported total losses of NPR 17,989,500 with a median loss of NPR 391,000.
